s00-02-story-837dba.wav.text: Frogs fill the palace. Hail falls with fire inside it.

s00-03-story-0e54ae.wav.text: And then comes a darkness you can feel.

s00-04-talk-91f7ab.wav.text: Most people remember the ten plagues as a list of disasters.

s00-05-story-a29952.wav.text: An angry God, hitting Egypt again and again.

s00-06-pivot-2ebbd4.wav.text: But read it closely, and it's something else.

s07-01-grave-6ad359.wav.text: The last plague was the heaviest.

s07-02-story-ee0910.wav.text: At midnight, death would pass through the land, to every firstborn son.

s07-03-story-42ed64.wav.text: But God gave Israel a way through.

s07-04-story-faa980.wav.text: Each family killed a lamb, and painted its blood on the doorframe.

s07-05-grave-7f79f8.wav.text: And when I see the blood, I will pass over you

s07-06-story-7e15bb.wav.text: That night, a great cry went up across Egypt.

s07-07-story-ffab4c.wav.text: But behind the doors marked with blood, every child was safe.

s07-08-story-809e89.wav.text: By morning, Pharaoh was begging them to leave.
